# Third-party code

Copied in at fixed versions (only the files the overlay builds), each with its licence. Update by copying a newer
release over the folder and noting it here.

| Folder | Project | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| imgui | [Dear ImGui](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui): core and the Win32, Vulkan, DX11, DX12 and OpenGL3 backends | v1.93.0 | MIT |
| vulkan-headers | [Vulkan-Headers](https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers): the C headers, without the C++ ones | v1.4.364 | Apache-2.0 (and MIT for some files; see LICENSES) |
| minhook | [MinHook](https://github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook) | v1.3.4 | BSD-2-Clause |
